The '''Muzzli system''' was located in the [[Citlik sector/Legends|Citlik sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the items known as [[Muzzlian squill]]s.<ref name="Tales">{{WEGCite|story=Tales of the Smoking Blaster|book=Star Wars Gamemaster Handbook|stext=Tales of the ''Smoking Blaster''}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Muzzlian squill]]s|system=Muzzli [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Muzzli [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-15.<ref name="TEA" />
